rounds.prompt: How many real earthworms would you have to eat to match the calories in a 100 g (3.5 oz) bag of gummy worms?
rounds.source: USDA FoodData Central and Zoo Biology
rounds.qualifier: Count each earthworm as a full-grown nightcrawler, about 5 g (a sixth of an ounce).

rounds.prompt: How many days of the entire world's economic output would add up to Apple's stock market value?
rounds.source: IMF world GDP 2026, Apple close Oct 30
rounds.qualifier: Apple's value on October 30, 2026, against the IMF's 2026 world GDP.

rounds.prompt: How many claw machines are there in Japan?
rounds.qualifier: Counting the crane games in Japan's arcades, as of 2024.
